verdicts.reason: A reads left to right properly with headline, details and CTA, but the can graphic is distorted and the RSVP button sits on top of it. The missing-asset placeholder hangs under the CTA, and the reserve line is bigger than the date details. B shrinks the RSVP CTA to the size of a badge and lines it up with the tags, so the call to action gets lost. Its headline breaks across two lines, the logo text is damaged ('SOLST CE'), the copy is scattered in fragments, and the legal text and placeholder are crammed into the corner.
